It points to the national requirements and lists a few local 'if required' items. issues.detail: Status is wrong. Grokbot marked the page 'Link only (not readable: blocked/404/login)', but the page loads and is readable HTML. It is the council's validation requirements page.

issues.detail: The app_type_rows are all '(none) - not readable'. The page's stated requirements were not captured. They are: details of how a minimum 10% Biodiversity Net Gain will be delivered; an up-to-date Contaminated Land Survey if required; an up-to-date Flood Risk Assessment if required; an EIA if required; and a tree survey if required. These apply to the county's minerals, waste and Reg 3 applications.

summary: Grokbot's link is correct and works, but it wrongly recorded it as unreadable and captured nothing. The page has no formal local list but does set out a few local 'if required' items (BNG, contamination, FRA, EIA, tree survey) and file format rules.
